gaps.what: The interview names no systems, roles or partners the ticketing depends on, so no dependency entries carry asset_ids; a ticketing system (candidates in the register: Atlassian Jira Service Management or BMC Remedy) is presumable but unconfirmed.
gaps.ask: Which ticket system does HR service ticketing run on, and which staff and communication tools does it need in emergency operation?

gaps.what: No RPO for the ticket data was stated anywhere; the <24 h proposal rests on analyst judgement only.
gaps.ask: How long can recorded personnel-related requests be lost without harm, so the RPO can be fixed?

gaps.what: The impact grid was scored for the whole process; per sub-step scores were carried over unchanged rather than scored individually.
